solarProject.title: Smart Dual-Axis Solar Tracker
solarProject.subtitle: Automated Sun-Tracking Photovoltaic System
solarProject.selectedBy: Government High School Mazhar Ul Aloom Fort Abbas
solarProject.description: Fixed solar panels experience significant efficiency loss due to changing sun angles. Selected by school faculty to develop a Dual-Axis Solar Tracker using quad LDR photoresistors and micro servo actuators to keep the solar panel perpendicular to sunlight at all times.
highlights: Quad-LDR Sensor Matrix: Measures differential light across horizontal and vertical axes.
Dual Micro-Servo Actuation: Real-time azimuth rotation and elevation tilt.
Efficiency Maximization: Keeps perpendicular (90°) solar incidence for peak electrical output.

scouting.description: As a certified scout from Government High School Mazhar Ul Aloom Fort Abbas, I actively train in outdoor leadership, self-reliance, survival skills, emergency first aid, and public service.
scouting.campDetail: In August 2026, I had the privilege of attending the provincial scouting camp at Ghora Gali, Murree alongside our school teachers and student scout peers, completing advanced wilderness drills, mountain navigation, and team resilience training.
scouting.scoutLaw: A Scout is trustworthy, loyal, helpful, friendly, courteous, kind, obedient, cheerful, thrifty, brave, clean, and reverent.

novel.synopsis: 'سفرِ زیاں' (Safar-e-Zayan) is an introspective philosophical novel currently in its writing and drafting phase. It delves into the profound journey of a young protagonist traversing life's arduous trials, confronting personal losses (زیاں), exploring the dilemmas between worldly temptations and moral integrity, and ultimately discovering spiritual resilience and purposeful redemption.
